prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. In this 6-column by 3-row explosion animation atlas, edit ONLY THE MIDDLE ROW (row B). Keep the top and bottom rows unchanged. The middle-row explosion currently looks like a nearly mirror-symmetrical half-circle. Make that row unmistakably ASYMMETRICAL while keeping the SAME LOW DETAIL LEVEL, flat black silhouette, white background, approximate maximum width/height and six animation phases. Change the large-scale proportions and timing of the shape, not the quantity of details.

The blast stays anchored to one fixed ground contact point; it does not slide or become a projectile. At the peak, the RIGHT side rises into ONE larger rounded bulge while the LEFT side is short and flattened, approximately half the right side height. Give the crest an off-center slant, not a centered arch. When the opening appears it is offset toward the LEFT and diagonally slanted, leaving a thick tall rounded mass on the right and a thin short torn edge on the left. As it breaks, the left edge disappears FIRST while the larger right puff lingers; never produce two matching mirrored arcs or equal ground remnants. The final two frames have unequal low rounded remnants at different positions, then only one tiny low remnant. Clear directional imbalance throughout the whole sequence.

Keep only a few broad simple masses and the one broad inner opening. Avoid adding detail: NO new debris, no speckles, no tiny particles, no thin branches, no jets, no elaborate smoke curls, no ground cracks, no flames, no starburst. No perfect circle, symmetric dome, paired identical sides or evenly spaced lobes. Retain crisp pixel-art edges, pure black fill, empty white background and broad white gutters between cells. No text, grid, labels, gun or character. User wants the current restrained explosion, with genuinely different left and right silhouettes.
